# Indie Flow (인디플로우)

> Indie Flow lists publicly announced independent live music shows in Hongdae and nearby neighborhoods of Seoul, South Korea.

## Official site
- [Upcoming performances](https://indie-flow-production.up.railway.app/): Korean-language listings and date filters
- [English listings](https://indie-flow-production.up.railway.app/?lang=en): English interface
- [XML sitemap](https://indie-flow-production.up.railway.app/sitemap.xml): Published upcoming events

## Coverage and interpretation
- Primary area: Hongdae, Hapjeong, Sangsu and nearby Seoul neighborhoods.
- Each event page includes available show title, date/time, venue, address, price, and a source link.
- Information can change. Confirm cancellation, pricing and tickets at the linked original source.
- Walking times are straight-line approximations, not actual pedestrian routing estimates.
- Missing information does not mean a show is free, sold out or canceled.

## Machine-readable information
- Event detail pages include Schema.org MusicEvent structured data.
- The sitemap lists published, upcoming event pages.
- This document does not grant permission to scrape or republish third-party content.
